statement: Let a valid route from src to dst with at most k stops be a sequence of flight indices i_0, ..., i_{m-1} with m >= 1 and 0 <= i_j < len(flights) for every j with 0 <= j < m, such that flights[i_0][0] = src, flights[i_{m-1}][1] = dst, flights[i_j][1] = flights[i_{j+1}][0] for every j with 0 <= j < m-1, and m-1 <= k. Its total price is sum_{j=0}^{m-1} flights[i_j][2]. Let C be the set of all total prices of such valid routes. The function returns a result r and: if C is non-empty then r = min(C); if C is empty then r = -1.
preconditions: 1 <= n <= 100; len(flights) <= n*(n-1)/2; for every i with 0 <= i < len(flights), len(flights[i]) = 3, 0 <= flights[i][0] < n, 0 <= flights[i][1] < n, flights[i][0] != flights[i][1], and 1 <= flights[i][2] <= 10000; no two distinct indices i and j with 0 <= i < len(flights) and 0 <= j < len(flights) have flights[i][0] = flights[j][0] and flights[i][1] = flights[j][1]; 0 <= src < n; 0 <= dst < n; src != dst; 0 <= k < n.
